headline: I design custom site furniture and build the systems that make it easier to produce.
intro: I'm Dayton Massey. For the last six years I've engineered custom architectural products — guardrails, benches, planters, trellises — from first sketch through fabrication and installation. Along the way I started building the tools and processes behind the work: BOM automation, ERP workflows, and documentation systems. This site is my projects, my photography, and a notebook of whatever I'm working on, reading, or thinking about.
